name: Walk a canonical anchor's citers past page one
when: the anchor is a field-defining work with hundreds of citers and the sought works are books adjacent to the concept
shape: cites:<anchor> pages 2-3 (depth-weighted: top-3 anchors × 3 pages), optionally with a within-set filter term
ingredients: a within-set filter term when the citer set is large
yields: the adjacent books search never ranks (Rodgers' Age of Fracture sat at #119 of Harvey's citers — page 3)
misses: cited-by pages are unstable request to request; deep pages of a 10k-citer anchor are noise without a filter
origin: gs_revamp PR #192 forward canon (2026-09-01); PR #170 unstable cited-by pages
